283398328.description:
Product Overview:
This collection includes assorted mineral and stone specimens featuring a variety of rough and polished pieces. The set contains agate slices with notable blue and white patterns, a green mineral likely malachite, a rough reddish-brown mineral, and a white or cream-colored stone resembling onyx or calcite, some fashioned as a tealight candle holder.

Specifications:
- Includes both rough and polished mineral and stone specimens
- Features agate slices with distinct internal patterns
- Contains green mineral consistent with malachite
- Includes a rough reddish-brown mineral specimen
- Contains white or cream-colored stone resembling onyx or calcite
- Specimens vary in size, color, and texture
- Approximate total weight: 12 lbs

No brand or model information is provided with this lot.

283496745.description:
This listing includes three vintage glass insulators marked 'WHITALL TATUM No 1'. Manufactured by the Whitall Tatum company, these insulators were used for telegraph and power lines during the early to mid-20th century. The glass ranges from clear to slightly smoky in color. Each insulator measures approximately 3-4 inches in height. The items are in good vintage condition with surface wear and dirt consistent with age and outdoor use. No major cracks or chips are visible. Each piece features embossed manufacturer details on the base.
